notes.title: 0.12.7.133 More Fixes & Balancing
notes.content:
Hoowwwwdy y'all. Another smaller patch but fixing a lot of the bugs within the game.

I feel like it's now actually getting closer to something more playable, I'm really enjoying playing it myself at the moment and have noticed a few others in the discord managing to get a little bit further into the depths of the game.

I appreciate everyone's patience and feedback, trust me it all helps a lot.

And another little shout out to a community member, MachineLordZero who has been smashing the bug list out for me, giving me a clear direction of whats going wrong. It is, super, super appreciated!

==== PATCH NOTES ====

Are existing savefiles compatible?
- Yes - You do not need to make a new save file although it is recommended.

New:

- Followers can now have claims, which you can honor when defeating town leaders

- Hacking the same object over and over now makes it easier to hack

- Betraying a quest follower by trading them is now possible (fails the quest)

Fixes:

- Fixed Brawler quest dialog

- Fixed confirm action missing translation

- Fixed transfer character screen showing multiple of the same character

- Fixed edge case where two quest givers failed and start states conflicted (Brawler and Summer)

- Fixed town takeover not triggering

- Fixed lights rendering incorrectly (black fuzzy edges)

- Fixed text overflowing on object info pane (bottom right)

- Fixed taming quests breaking after accepting

- Fixed quest screen not showing quest information

- Removed keys and keysellers, doesn't seem to add much and hacking is more interesting

- Balanced Redtown to be a little bit easier

- Can now gather whole resource without stopping

- Slightly moved where quests spawn to avoid overlapping lamp posts

- Increased resource health x10 so they last longer

- Couple more renderer improvements to reduce stuttering

- Removed sandtick from taming quests since it's a bit lame

- Reduced cull batching to be less aggressive (helps with travelling)

notes.title: 0.12.5.130 Optimizations
notes.content:
Hoowwwwdy y'all. Just a smaller patch that won't really change much in terms of functionality but aims to improve some of the stuttering issues people have been experiencing. I'm not 100% sure if this covers all the stuttering issues as there are many different devices to support, this should certainly help in most circumstances.

There is a lot of other stuff I need to get around to so I thought I should get this out now as it can impact people a lot.

For any techies interested, here is a typical tick, and how much is taken on the game logic is highlighted in the animation frame being fired, so anything that extends this time is what we're looking out for.

https://imgur.com/a/L2o2yry

In the patch notes I highlight the areas which were found to be taking far too long (for example all items could take up to 15ms each on a system with it's CPU emulated to 4x slower than my own.)

I also spotted an opportunity to optimize the way the threads communicate, but this will take longer and is a bit riskier to the codebase stability so I will make this a task I look at on the longer term while focusing on the main game features.

==== PATCH NOTES ====

Are existing save files compatible?
- Yes - You do not need to make a new save file.

Fixes:

- Optimized how the grid is loaded

- Optimized how the grid is saved
 - https://imgur.com/a/WrzBE9d

- Optimized how the grid is redrawn (seemed to redraw when it wasn't necessary)
-  https://imgur.com/a/8ITK4kx

- Optimized the way the UI copy of characters are rendered (it was taking 15ms on 4x emulated slowdown)
 - https://imgur.com/a/TXDmE7B (screenshot on a system with 4x slower CPU speed emulated, which helps 'stretch' issues out longer for easier visibility)

- Optimized the way items are unloaded, they appeared to take a while.
 - https://imgur.com/a/mmi8fBl

- Fixed characters looking backwards while running sometimes

- Fixed a framerate issue that was locking FPS
 - Thanks to sugartitty in the community for this, came in clutch investigating the compiled code!

- Fixed last patch breaking culling

- Fixed cancel hacking not working so well

- Fixed species name not showing correctly in dialogs

notes.title: Early Access Release ! 0.12.0.116
notes.content:
==== Announcement ===

Finally Early Access is upon us! The steam has gone live and everyone will be able to play the Early Access version, which boasts many new features, including factions quests, the Yamakai faction and a rework to several of the systems you all helped test during the demo testing.

And with that, some notes on my thoughts going into the release. Feel free to skip this bit if you just want patch notes.

Over the last year I've had many people help test the game, give their feedback, critical and pleasant - all which was super appreciated. With every bit of feedback we've gone away and made changes, tweaks, added new things taking on board the players feedback. The pace of my development as a solo developer was intense and unwavering - and yet there are still things I want this game to achieve - There is a reason the map is absolutely enormous, I understand that makes things harder and take longer. I welcome this challenge. I've remade the map 3 times to get to this size which I think provides the world big enough and "real" enough for me to build the game world upon.

So with that said, scope creep, too much too take on, all of the usual... I embraced it, and continue to from time to time. Everytime I add another mechanic in the game, it explores something new. Everytime I tweak an NPC, the interactions feel more real. Everytime players play it, they come back with weird and wonderful ideas.

The exploration space of this game is so enjoyable, I could see myself exploring it for the next few years happily - even after the 4 years I've already spent on it. I don't think I was ever trying to make a game, I'm trying to make a machine, a machine that allows players to invent, explore and do weird things. I believe this mindset doesn't set you up for making a solid and tight small RPG, I don't know where it leads us if I'm honest, but I know player will enjoy exploring and breaking the machine.

Do I think we're ready for the public? No... But isn't that exactly what early access is for? I really need more feedback, help and testing to finish the game. With that, it's important the price point of the game reflect the reality of the product as it stands, which does still have bugs, and not all the quests and stories I want are in (although it does have pretty much every feature!). With that said I thought it was important to set a realistic price for the game while we are in the early stages of Early Access. This price will likely change as time goes progresses and the product becomes more solid.

==== PATCH NOTES ====

Are existing savefiles compatible?
- No - Please create an entirely new savefile


New:

- Added Morale to faction members
  (Decreases with negative actions such as sleeping on floor or starving)
  (Increase with positive actions such as eating, and sleeping in comfortable beds)
- Added Loyalty to faction members
  (Decreases while morale is low)
  (Increases while morale is high)
  (Can cause members to fall out with the faction leader)
- Albear mutation, your little mutating buddy who can help revive you from the dead.
- Discoveries system, this is a learning aid to help understand the world and how to survive in it
- Introduced a game director which can help balance the games spawns, traders, loot and generate interesting encounters
  (The game director is currently customized by tweaking the different difficulty settings in advanced start)
- Skin/Harvest any creature
  (Different species provide different resources)
- Morale and Loyalty stats which are effected by food quality, bed quality and other factors
- Sleep anywhere without a bed, decreases morale over time
- New stats screen bringing inspiration from Rimworlds stat screen, to show more of the hidden stats
- New stats screen for objects too
- New player card (bottom left), tighter and frees up some screen space
  (Can be scaled in settings menu)
- Mutations system & screen completely redone
  Taking inspiration from Stellaris traits and Project Zomboid traits.
  Should be a bit easier to look at, measure and experiment with mutations now
- Founders and Founderkin can now build using cash rather than resources (toggle-able)
- Can now uproot resources to get rid of them completely
- Resource nodes (e.g. trees, rocks) now get consumed and are removed after being fully harvested
- All containers in the world are now locked and require hacking
- Can now show labels for Pickup Items (Defaults to Left Alt)
- People in the world now speak and interact a lot more with the player
- All animals now have their own factions
- Ice Bandits faction, Yamakai Faction, Lokals Faction, FTC Faction now added (But not all towns and quests fully implemented)
- Many more faction related quests to improve faction reputation and change the relations between factions
- Ice Peak, Nugarden and Olgarden, the first three towns for the Yamakai faction
- The Caverns, the first town for the Lokals faction
- Bogden, the first town for the FTC Faction
- Ability to speak to Animals, this can cause quests to spawn from Animals.
- New world states which trigger on certain events, days and faction states.
- Some more AI interactivity which paves the way for new tech in future, e.g. picking up dead or injured allies.

Fixes:

The list is huge and the full breakdown is on github, but here are the last few check off:

- Revive should now be more consistent
- Re-added the speed controls
- Wild spawning tweaked
- Renamed BP to Science to make it easier to understand
- Animals no longer stay upside down after death or sleeping
- Doors should no longer disappear
- Stealing and faction reactions should now be consistent and make sense

notes.title: Enormously Huge Update 0.10.0.96
notes.content:
Important: If you installed before Jan 2025 please uninstall and re-install the demo.

A huge update with tons of new additions aswell as fixing a lot of the problems with the building mechanics and overall making it a little more stable. Also including a lot of new faction feature additions and town/economy features also the new inventory and follower changes to animals and species. 

I finally got around to adding steam achievements as well as resolving the issues with steam overlay (what a challenge!).

A whole new and overhauled research tree to make it easier to identify new research. Research is powered with Brain Power, which can be gained from Research Nodes from shops, or you can hunt creatures and NPCs and extract their brains on the splicing table.

Towns can now be taken over by different factions aswell as the highest faction becoming the dominant faction thus invoking their will (and world states) upon the desert.

There are maaaaany many more quests and world state changes as a result of these.

More languages and localizations have also been added to the game.

==== PATCH NOTES ====

Are existing savefiles compatible?
- No - Please create an entirely new savefile

Highlights:

- Towns now change ownership after their leader is defeated
- Advanced start now allows every species to be picked and more spawn locations added
- Overhauled research tree
- Landzo City, Little Apple and Redtown Town Completely reworked
- Animals can now be tamed using their preferred diets
- Cloning machines now use DNA to spawn new creatures
- Extracting DNA now has a chance to also extract abilities (chance scaling on INT)

New:

- Choose between Allies, Enemies or The Desert to decide who takes over a town
- Townspeople like shop keepers, guards and more are replaced when a faction takes over
- Almost any faction can own almost any town, including mutant and creature factions
- Scenario starts can now also be editted when clicking Advanced
- Research is now fueled by brains
- Animal inventories with varying slot sizes
- Any world item can now be picked up if you're strong enough!
- Smaller Animal brains with limited functionality (maybe you can figure out how to expand their functionality ;))
- Refactor of brain gameplay so it's more consistent and easier to manage/track and also present in wiki
- Brains now effect creatures ability to do certain actions, e.g. talk
- More over world faction bases to raid
- Backpacks now work and reduce weight by half
- Steam Achievements - You can now go achievement hunting!
- World tab for factions now shows faction description and relations
- Every unique NPC now has a job (at writing this is mostly for faction heirarchies and lore, later will effect AI)
- Moved abilities wheel to instead be a list on the left which resolves a few UX issues
- New notifications at bottom of screen and a player log with all world changes
- Quests list now shows the message that was said by the quest giver
- Smart text which allows you to hover important words and learn more about their meaning
- Changed MP to cost much less and MP points are earned overtime with overall MP Progress from all sources
- Added biology cell visuals to quick start menu as well as many other various UI and UX tweaks
- Building in zones other than the desert classes as trespassing unless you have a permit or are allies
- Lots of new animals with unique stats, inventories and abilities
- Areas can now be offlimits and entering them will be a trespassing crime
- Crafting now goes directly to inventory (or drops on floor)
- Backpacks now can be equipt and half the weight of their inventory
- Ability power now scales off stats, e.g. higher CHR means more consistent follower based abilities
- Removed follower limit since cooldowns now control this aspect of gameplay
- Player now automatically runs to pickup items and chat with NPCs that are far away
- Animals abilities vary with rarity and not all animals will have all their species abilities
- Lots more mutations, including mutations you can take from animals or other clones
- New mutation and ability types such as passively doing extra damage during fights (e.g. bite the attacker periodically with mandibles)
- Can now see stat modifiers much easier, for example items which increase Intelligence
- Now that all species can spawn, only clone and mutated clone can unlock mutations with MP but you still always earn MP
- New languages: Turkish, Ukrainian

Fixes:

- Quality now changes items stats correctly
- Spawned NPC now have different item qualities
- Steam overlay, and screenshots now works
- Crafting can now generate higher quality items
- Removed lots of old incorrect brains
- Fixed player not inheriting correct species base stats at game start
- Improved resource gathering to be a bit quicker
- Improved building to be a bit quicker
- Fixes around dropoff/hauling jobs
- Fixed spacebar doesn't always pause game
- Fixed commands now action after unpausing
- Refactored grid chunks save/load to be seperate lists in code
- Leaders now show as defeated on factions screen if defeated
- Side mouse buttons no longer load old saves
- Fixed portraits not showing at top left
- Fixed double clicking items make them disappear
- Fixed abilities not applying their cooldowns
- Press I/Tab now toggles inventory open/close correctly
- Crafting issues now resolved since crafting goes to inventory
- Training dummy now has a texture and works
- Resurrection through any means now works
- Status effects were sometimes inconsistent, they should now be more stable when pausing etc.
- Can now target self or clones with abilities
- Actions menu/Object Info no longer incorrectly shows up bottom left
- Fixed some audio issues, audio should now be correctly spatial in 3D space.
- Some draft NPCs, factions, descriptions, names or information have been updated or removed
- All species base speed and base weight now factored in
- All weapons rebalanced
- All armor rebalanced

notes.content:
0.9.4.79 Patch Notes & Announcement

==== Announcement ===

The DEMO will be TAKEN OFFLINE between 5th-11th November since we will be going into "Double-down" mode on the game, adding many missing creatures, factions, items, crafting recipes and more. As a result of all the feedback and testing we had from the demo, we think it's a good time to make our "go to Early Access plans" which includes making a special beta build on the main game, rather than having a demo.

Anyone with the demo before that time will still be able to play the demo, but it will eventually stop receiving updates.

Players will still be able to JOIN IN TESTING through the beta and anyone who already has a key from giveaways or from testing can continue to play on the main game. (Essentially anyone on discord will still be able to access and play the game one way or another).

To join the discord and help with development visit here: https://discord.gg/CmSFawGNeU

We will also be focusing hard on streamlining and optimising features such as building and bases since right now it does not work exactly how we want. We are also remaking some of the main towns and cities to be more enjoyable and explorable.

There are also some new channels in the discord we hope to bring to your attention

The #cast-your-vote channel is for you to directly influence and help guide developers on the most important features and aspects of the game.

The #base-building-feedback channel under bugs, which has been created specifically for handling base building issues, mechanics and improvements.

==== UPDATE ====

Fixes for path finding, some optimisations, new creatures and some new settings.

notes.content:
0.9.0.59 Patch Notes

==== UPDATE ====

As many demo bugfixes as we could fit in this week! These were all raised by community members and so I want to say a huge thank you, it means a lot to us! Thanks everybody who has helped!

This will be available on steam (auto updates your demo for you) by around 10-11pm UK time.

There will likely be another patch on Friday or Saturday, to cover more of the fixes.

==== PATCH NOTES ====


Are existing savefiles compatible?
[list]
[*] Yes - Although they may be polluted with old data causing lag. New game recommended
[/list]

New:

[list]
[*] More SFX for weapons.
[*] Admin Keys container in level editor (Contains all keys).
[*] Additional credits for all the help (thanks everybody!).
[*] Demo only, unlocked 3 abilities at start since some people struggled to utilize them.
[*] Status knockout now shows seconds.
[*] Status hostile now shows when enemies are hostile to you or an enemy to your faction.
[*] Status is now colored so easier to see when in danger.
[/list]

Balance:

[list]
[*] Combat should feel ALOT better, with so many bugfixes and stat changes.
[*] Faster ranged weapons (snappy!).
[*] Improved ranged weapon damage (some weapons).
[/list]

Fixes:

[list]
[*] Stay still when using ranged, get closer when using melee now working.
[*] Stealing no longer lasts forever (now 10 seconds).
[*] Enemies should no longer ignore you when hostile.
[*] Item descriptions no longer go off screen.
[*] Can now take bounty from Gee (was called G).
[*] Harder to get stuck in walls during fights.
[*] Followers stop a little bit further away from leader.
[*] Doors & Shopkeepers no longer show a black line.
[*] Heal ability no longer targets objects, life only.
[*] Fixed other abilities targeting invalid object.
[*] Stop some status effects stacking (healing, dead, etc...).
[*] Spacebar now pauses the game.
